answer: Funding-lineage caps: every agent's first POA must arrive on-chain, so the ledger can trace each wallet's funding vine back to its root. Identities sharing a root form one cluster that splits a single reward cap, however many names it spawns. To dodge this, an attacker must seed each sybil through a separate voyage of mixers and fresh exchange accounts, paying fees and onboarding checks per branch, so a thousand fakes need a thousand clean origins yet still earn no more copper than one honest agent.
